Izintengo zansuku zonke: Binance · kubalwa kabusha cishe njalo emahoreni angu-3
Ibala ukuthi mangaki kuma-altcoin amakhulu acishe abe ngu-20 (isb. Ethereum, Solana, XRP) enze kangcono kune-Bitcoin ezinsukwini ezingu-90 ezedlule. Inani yingxenye yawo kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-100.
Izintengo: Binance noma Bybit · kulayishwa kabusha cishe njalo emizuzwini engu-15

Uma i-dominance inyuka, i-Bitcoin yenza kangcono kunemakethe esele; uma yehla, amanye ama-coin athola isisindo. Ama-stablecoin nawo ayabalwa: uma inani lawo likhula, ingxenye ye-Bitcoin iyehla ngisho noma intengo ye-Bitcoin ihlala ifana.
Umthombo: CoinGecko · kulayishwa kabusha cishe njalo emizuzwini engu-30
Ingxenye ye-Bitcoin enanini eliphelele lawo wonke ama-cryptocurrency (i-market capitalization). Ngaphansi kwayo kunengxenye ye-Ethereum.

Ngaphansi kuka-25 kusho ukwesaba okukhulu, ngaphezu kuka-75 umhawu omkhulu, cishe u-50 akuchemile. Uma linwetshiwe, ikhadi libonisa amanani ezolo, eviki eledlule nenyanga edlule. Akusona isignali sokuthenga noma sokuthengisa.
Umthombo: alternative.me · inani elisha kanye ngosuku

Inkomba yomoya yemakethe ye-crypto kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-100. I-alternative.me iyibala kusukela kokokufaka okuningana, okuhlanganisa ukuguquguquka kwentengo, ivolumu yokuhweba, inkundla yezokuxhumana ne-Bitcoin dominance.

Amanani aphezulu asho ukuthi inethiwekhi imatasa futhi ukudlulisa kubiza kakhulu. Kancane, okuvamile nokusheshayo yizimali zokuqinisekisa kamuva noma ngokushesha. Uma linwetshiwe, ikhadi libonisa izindleko ezilinganiselwe zokudlulisa okulula.
Ama-node e-RPC omphakathi, mempool.space · kulayishwa kabusha njalo ngomzuzu

Ukuthi umsebenzi ubiza malini njengamanje kunethiwekhi ngayinye. Ku-Ethereum nakumanethiwekhi afanayo nge-gwei (ingxenye eyodwa kwesigidigidi ye-ETH ngeyunithi ngayinye ye-gas), ku-Bitcoin nge-sat/vB (ama-satoshi ngebhayithi ngalinye elibonakalayo lomsebenzi).

Usuku: kusukela ekuphakameni kwe-block nesikhathi esimaphakathi se-block (mempool.space), uma kungenjalo ngekhalenda · umlando wentengo: Coin Metrics, Binance, kulayishwa kabusha njalo emahoreni angu-12

Ku-halving, umvuzo abavukuzi abawuthola nge-block entsha ye-Bitcoin uhlukaniswa phakathi. Lokhu kwenzeka njalo kuma-block angu-210,000, cishe njalo eminyakeni emine. Ngemuva kwalokho, kudalwa ama-bitcoin amasha ayingxenye kuphela ngosuku.

Inothi livela kuphela uma usuku olunjalo kungolwanamuhla noma kusasa. Ngesikhathi sokukhishwa, izintengo zivamise ukuguquguquka kakhulu kunokuvamile. I-app ibonisa usuku kuphela, hhayi izibalo ngokwazo.
Ikhalenda evela kuwebhusayithi ye-app · ilayishwa kanye ngosuku

Izinsuku zedatha ebalulekile yomnotho wase-US: ukwehla kwenani lemali (CPI, PCE), izintengo zabakhiqizi (PPI), umbiko wemisebenzi nezinqumo zenzalo ze-US Federal Reserve. Izibalo ezinjalo zivamise ukunyakazisa nezintengo ze-crypto.
Binance, Coin Metrics · izintengo njalo ngehora, amanani e-on-chain alayishwa kabusha njalo emahoreni angu-12

Isihloko sisho indlela; nweba ikhadi ukuze uthole imininingwane. Ukunyakaza okubanzi kusho ukuthi ama-coin amakhulu amaningi anyakaza ngendlela efanayo. Umoya we-leverage onethemba usho ukuthi abahwebi abaningi babheja ngokwenyuka kwezintengo nge-leverage, kulinganiswa ngezinga le-funding le-Bitcoin futures. Isithombe sesikhashana, hhayi isibikezelo.
Binance, CoinGecko · kulayishwa kabusha cishe njalo emizuzwini engu-5

Isifinyezo esifushane semakethe emahoreni angu-24 adlule: ukuthi i-Bitcoin, Ethereum ne-Solana kunyakaza kanjani, mangaki kuma-coin amakhulu kakhulu ayenyuka noma ayehla, ingakanani i-Bitcoin ehwebelanwayo njengamanje nokuthi unjani umoya we-leverage (kulinganiswa ngezinga le-funding le-Bitcoin futures).

Ngakwesokudla kunoshintsho lwenani eliphelele emahoreni angu-24. Ivolumu ephezulu isho ukuthi kuhwebelanwa kakhulu – ayisho ukuthi kuya ngakuphi. Kuboniswa ngemali yokuguqula lapho kungenzeka khona, uma kungenjalo ngamadola aseMelika.
Wonke ama-coin · CoinGecko · kulayishwa kabusha cishe njalo emizuzwini engu-30
Inani eliphelele lawo wonke ama-cryptocurrency (i-market capitalization: intengo iphindwe ngenani elisakazekile, kuhlanganiswe kuwo wonke ama-coin) nevolumu yokuhweba yamahora angu-24 adlule.
I-coin ngayinye ibonisa okuphawulekayo kwayo kakhulu, noshintsho lwamahora angu-24 ngakwesokudla. Ivolumu engu-2× isho ukuphindwe kabili kokuhweba okuvamile. Okuphawulekayo akusho okuhle noma okubi.
